title: Coordinate Independence of a Discrete Derivative
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $q$ be a real-valued function on the sign cube $\\{-1,1\\}^n$. If changing coordinate $j$ leaves $q$ unchanged, then for any coordinate $i\\ne j$, the discrete derivative of $q$ in coordinate $i$, given at $x$ by $[q(x^{i\\gets 1})-q(x^{i\\gets -1})]/2$, is also unchanged when coordinate $j$ is changed.
